name: Amanzoe
positioning: Aman's hilltop resort of pool pavilions and villas in the Peloponnese, designed like a modern-day Acropolis
best_for: Travelers who want a quiet, secluded resort away from nightlife
Guests who want yoga, Pilates and spa time in a private pavilion setting

facts.text: Amanzoe is a 2.5-hour drive from Athens International Airport.
The pavilions have double-height ceilings and sliding wooden doors that open onto a walled, shaded terrace and plunge pool.
Accommodation at Amanzoe includes complimentary movement classes (yoga and Pilates) in group sessions.
Accommodation at Amanzoe includes use of all non-motorised watersports equipment at the Beach Club.
Amanzoe offers a private candlelit dinner in the Library.
Amanzoe's restaurants are open to Aman guests and non-residents, subject to availability.
The wellness facilities include a Watsu pool, a yoga pavilion and a Pilates studio.
Kilada, a fishing port with tavernas, is a 15-minute drive from Amanzoe.

highlights.text: Amanzoe is deliberately designed like a modern-day Acropolis and sits on a hilltop with views of the valleys and seas of the Peloponnese.
Amanzoe serves a Greek degustation menu in its open-air Amphitheatre.
The sanctuary of Asclepius and the amphitheater of Epidaurus, where outdoor performances take place in summer, are less than an hour's drive from Amanzoe.
The Akari Moriawase guided dining experience gives guests a direct view into the kitchen from their table.
The changing areas include a hammam, sauna, cold plunge and steam room.

considerations.text: Amanzoe has no nightlife, hip dining scene or cool shopping nearby; its appeal is isolation.
The drive from Athens International Airport takes 2.5 hours.
WhataHotel notes the remote location requires transportation to nearby attractions.
